newsitem.title: USA: Tektronix, Mitsubishi Electronics in pact.
newsitem.headline: Tektronix, Mitsubishi Electronics in pact.

text.p: Tektronix Inc said on Monday it formed a strategic partnership with Mitsubishi Electronics America Inc to jointly design, develop and make color printers.

The partnership combined Tektronix' color printing abilities with Mitsubishi's in precision manufacturing, Tektronix said. It would initially support and expand manufacturing capacity for solid ink color printers used in the graphic arts market, the company said.

"This strategic partnership with Mitsubishi validates the market strength of our technology while augmenting our ability to satisfy customer demand for Phaser color printers," Jean Nassar, vice president of worldwide marketing for Tektronix' Color Printing and Imaging Division, said.
Mitsubishi Electronics is the largest subsidiary of Mitsubishi Electric America Inc.
